profile.goal: 让北方怕冷的人想冬天去海南
inferred: 受众是北方城市的年轻人和家庭
主要发朋友圈和小红书
defaulted: 概念用“冬天留在登机口”
方向 clean-minimal 换成海蓝色

content.headline:
冬天
留在登机口
content.sub: 落地就能脱掉外套，椰风海浪都在等你

concept.idea_en: you take winter off the moment you land
concept.scene: 海南机场的停机坪，飞机舱门口的舷梯上，阳光非常亮。一个年轻女孩刚走出舱门，笑着把一件厚厚的黑色羽绒服从肩膀上脱下来，羽绒服滑到一只手臂上，露出里面颜色鲜艳的扶桑花衬衫，墨镜推在头顶。背景是湛蓝的天空和几棵高高的椰子树。
concept.scene_en: On the boarding stairs of a plane at a sunny tropical airport in Hainan, very bright sunlight. A young Chinese woman has just stepped out of the cabin door, laughing as she peels a thick black puffy winter down jacket off her shoulders; the jacket slides down onto one arm, revealing a vivid hibiscus print shirt underneath, sunglasses pushed up on her head. Behind her a deep blue sky and a few tall coconut palms.
concept.interlock: 标题在画面上方，左对齐分两行。女孩站得离标题很近，她的头顶和推在头上的墨镜挡在第二行“登”“机”两个字的下沿前面，最多盖住字高的五分之一，其余的字完整露出。羽绒服一直挂在她手臂上，不要有任何东西飘在字旁边
concept.interlock_en: The headline sits in the upper part, two left-aligned lines. She stands close below it, so the top of her head and the sunglasses pushed up in her hair overlap the bottom edge of the characters 登 and 机 on the second line, covering at most a fifth of their height; every other character stays fully visible. The jacket stays on her arm; nothing floats next to the letters.
concept.headline_style: 超大号白色粗黑体，左对齐两行，带一点柔和的投影
concept.headline_style_en: huge white heavy Chinese sans serif, two left-aligned lines, with a soft subtle shadow
concept.look: 明亮通透的热带阳光照片，电影感，天空湛蓝，暖金色的光，色彩饱和但自然，带一点胶片颗粒
concept.look_en: Bright, airy tropical sunlight photograph, cinematic, deep clear blue sky, warm golden light, saturated yet natural colours, a touch of film grain.
